```plato
    // The world after re-applying row `index`'s already-accumulated impulses to its
    // two bodies. Run once before the iteration begins, this is what makes warm
    // starting mean anything: the row remembers last frame's impulse, and the
    // bodies must be moving as if it had been applied before the solver measures
    // anything.
    WarmStartRow(world: RigidWorld3D, index: Integer): RigidWorld3D
    {
        var row = world.Constraints[index];
        var stored = row.Normal.Vector * row.NormalImpulse.Amount
            + row.Tangent.Vector * row.TangentImpulse.Amount
            + row.Bitangent.Vector * row.BitangentImpulse.Amount;
        return RigidWorld3D(
            ReplacedAt(
                ReplacedAt(world.Bodies, row.BodyA.Value,
                    ApplyImpulse(world.Bodies[row.BodyA.Value], stored.Negative, row.Point)),
                row.BodyB.Value,
                ApplyImpulse(world.Bodies[row.BodyB.Value], stored, row.Point)),
            world.Constraints,
            world.Gravity,
            world.TimeStep,
            world.Solver);
    }
```
